title: Spreading a stalkwise elementary generator chain
statement: Let i:Z -> V be a closed immersion, e:U -> V etale, and let f,g be two length-c tuples of global functions on U whose zero subscheme squares are pullbacks of i along e. For every point x of U there exists an affine open neighbourhood W such that the restrictions of f and g to W are related by the reflexive transitive closure of unit scalings, swaps of distinct entries, and shears. This is the algebraic/geometric local chain statement only, with no cohomological assertion.

proof.text: Choose an affine open N containing x. Pull back both given squares to N and apply the source-library span_eq_of_isPullback_zeroLocusSubschemeι to identify the generated ideals. Send this equality to the stalk via the germ ring homomorphism. The ideal is a finite module, and the two tuples span it. Apply exists_elementary_generating_tuple_change over the local stalk ring and forget the matrix witnesses, obtaining the reflexive transitive chain.

Lift a finite family of germs simultaneously to sections after shrinking, by finite-set induction and exists_le_germ_eq. Likewise shrink until a finite family of equal-germ sections is equal using germ_eq. For one elementary move lift its coefficient; for a unit shrink further using isUnit_res_of_isUnit_germ. The resulting elementary move has the desired endpoint germs.

Induct on reflexive transitive chains using reflexivity, singleton edges and transitivity. At a transitive join restrict both representatives to their intersection and shrink until their middle tuples agree, then concatenate the restricted chains. Finally shrink until the outer endpoint sections equal the restrictions of the original f and g. Choose an affine subopen and transport its sections with topIso. Restriction ring maps preserve all three operations. The empty tuple gives the reflexive case.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_frame_local_generator_chain {V Z U : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : Z ⟶ V) [IsClosedImmersion i] (e : U ⟶ V) [Etale e] (c : ℕ)
    (f g : Fin c → Γ(U, ⊤))
    (tf : U.zeroLocusSubscheme (Set.range f) ⟶ Z)
    (tg : U.zeroLocusSubscheme (Set.range g) ⟶ Z)
    (hf : IsPullback tf (U.zeroLocusSubschemeι (Set.range f)) i e)
    (hg : IsPullback tg (U.zeroLocusSubschemeι (Set.range g)) i e)
    (x : U) :
    ∃ W : U.Opens, x ∈ W ∧ IsAffineOpen W ∧
      Relation.ReflTransGen FrameElementaryMove
        (fun k ↦ W.ι.appTop (f k)) (fun k ↦ W.ι.appTop (g k))
